title: Discrete Approximation to Time-changed Brownian Motions
abstract: We develop a general discrete approximation scheme for time-changed Brownian motions on $\mathbb{R}^d$. Our approximation scheme works for any smooth measure with full quasi-support on $\mathbb{R}^d$ with suitable initial distributions. Under some mild conditions on the smooth measure, the discrete approximation scheme works for every starting point. Our results in particular give a discrete approximation scheme for Liouville Brownian motions.
